[原文翻譯：Today Apple announced the M6 chip, the first product in a new generation of chips, and the A20 Pro that will appear in the iPhone 18 Pro of the same series is also coming soon. Here are the iPhone 18 Pro performance predictions revealed by the M6.]

[原文翻譯：The M6 reveals that the A20 Pro in the iPhone 18 Pro will see major gains in performance and power efficiency]

[原文翻譯：September isn't here yet, but Apple today surprised with two new products: the new Mac mini and Mac Studio. (Available to order today: Mac mini, Mac Studio.)]

[原文翻譯：The Mac mini features Apple's next-generation M6 chip, which is from the same chip family as the A20 Pro coming to the iPhone 18 Pro.]

[原文翻譯：The following is what Apple announced via Apple Newsroom:]

[原文翻譯：The M6 uses cutting-edge 2-nanometer process technology, packing higher transistor density into a smaller chip, delivering major leaps in performance and power efficiency. The M6 also introduces a dual 16-core Neural Engine with peak compute of 2x the previous generation, enabling faster on-device AI workflows. […] The M6 features a new 12-core CPU architecture, two more cores than M5, with 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores. It delivers the world's fastest single-threaded performance, with multi-threaded performance up to 1.2x faster than M5.]

[原文翻譯：The M6 will ultimately be positioned as more powerful than the new A20 Pro chip in the iPhone 18 Pro. That's always been the case with Mac- and iPad-class M-series chips.]

[原文翻譯：But since the M6 and A20 Pro are in the same chip family, the upgrades announced for the M6 are expected to carry over to the A20 Pro.]

[原文翻譯：Most notably, the A20 Pro will adopt the new 2-nanometer process that Apple is highlighting, delivering the 'major leap in performance and power efficiency' that the M6 achieves.]

[原文翻譯：We've previously speculated that the move to 2-nanometer would bring larger-than-usual performance gains. The M6 details confirm that.]

[原文翻譯：The A20 Pro may not have the same CPU and GPU core counts as the M6. The dual 16-core Neural Engine configuration is also unknown. But thanks to 2-nanometer technology, it should bring major improvements in the two areas Apple highlighted today: performance and power efficiency.]

[原文翻譯：How big the actual year-over-year gains will be is hard to say right now. But when the iPhone 18 Pro launches in a few weeks, performance and power efficiency will be the key upgrade points for the A20 Pro.]
